title: Attributes
description: Growing and shrinking the greeter with the scale attribute

console: animus create greeter name=greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5
animus create trader type=minecraft:llama name=trader world=world x=4.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.result: Attributes of greeter lists every attribute a player body has
The greeter is taller; chat shows scale set to 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 and 1.4
Attributes of greeter again; the scale lore reads Now 1.4
The greeter shrinks; chat: Set attributes.scale to 0.6 on greeter
A Reset line in chat; scale is back to the vanilla default 1
The greeter is back at its normal size

closing: Scale changed the greeter size, and sneak right click reset it
